basic_info.description: Welcome to this meticulously rebuilt luxury residence in the heart of the Sunset District. Every detail has been thoughtfully upgraded, including new electrical and plumbing systems, Marvin windows, a new roof, and more.This exceptional home offers 3 spacious bedrooms, a versatile den perfect as a fourth bedroom, and 4.5 designer bathrooms, delivering a perfect balance of comfort and functionality. Enjoy radiant floor heating throughout, an open-concept living space illuminated by three skylights, and a chef's kitchen outfitted with Thermador appliances, sleek European-style cabinetry, and a large island ideal for gatherings. A striking 3D fireplace and wide-plank engineered wood floors add warmth and contemporary flair. The primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a floating balcony with ocean views. The lower level is designed to impress with a spacious entertainment room, complete with a wet bar, custom sauna, and 3-panel bifold glass doors that open to a beautifully landscaped backyard.Fully smart home ready, this residence is equipped with CAT-6 wiring, an IPTV camera system, 200-amp electrical service, and 1-car garage parking. A rare fusion of luxury, technology, and indoor-outdoor livingthis is Sunset living at its finest.
